question: Which mantras must be chanted and at what time before the main rite?
premises: The mantras are identified as time-soul-eternal mantras.
The chanting occurs on the previous day.
inference: The practitioner must chant the time-soul-eternal mantras on the day before the main ritual.
uncertainties: The precise identity of kālātmanityāmantrāḥ depends on tradition-specific knowledge.
